_comment: Single source of truth for manuscript PDFs.
'match' is a distinctive phrase from the publication's title on the page.
tools/unbundle.py uses it to find the right card and attach a PDF link, so
the wiring survives re-exports even if wording around it changes.
To add a paper: add an entry here, drop papers/<slug>.pdf in, done.
'access' is only documentation, and drives the guidance table in
papers/README.md. 'open' = open access, post the published PDF freely.
'restricted' = subscription journal, usually accepted manuscript only.
